definitions.explanation: Paper currency issued by a government.

examples.japanese: {千円札|せんえんさつ}で{払|はら}う。
{財布|さいふ}に{一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}が{一枚|いちまい}しかない。
examples.english: I only have one 10,000-yen bill in my wallet.

notes:
{札|さつ} refers to paper money (banknotes).

JAPANESE BILLS:
- {千円札|せんえんさつ}: 1,000 yen bill (Noguchi Hideyo)
- {五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}: 5,000 yen bill (Tsuda Umeko)
- {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}: 10,000 yen bill (Shibusawa Eiichi)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {札|さつ}で{払|はら}う: to pay with bills
- {札|さつ}を{崩|くず}す: to break a bill (get change)
- お{札|さつ}: banknote (polite)
- {新札|しんさつ}: new/crisp bill

CONTRAST WITH COINS:
- {札|さつ}: bills, paper money
- {硬貨|こうか}/{小銭|こぜに}: coins

KANJI READING NOTE:
{札|さつ} = bill; {札|ふだ} = tag, label, card
